ModelCharacter: A large three-stateroom Gulfstar motor yacht whose enclosed, air-conditioned aft deck becomes the main salon. Twin high-output diesels, semi-displacement hull and small line-handling cockpit give it genuine 12–17-knot cruising capability while retaining a long keel and traditional Gulfstar teak interior.
DesignLineage: The Gulfstar 49 Motor Yacht was produced from 1984–1987.
It was an evolutionary refinement of Gulfstar's 48-footer built from 1981–1983.
The defining change is the fully enclosed aft deck used as the main salon, with the mid-level deckhouse devoted to galley and dinette.
The 49 belongs to Gulfstar's later performance motor-yacht lineage and is distinct from the slower 44 Motor Cruiser and earlier sail-derived trawlers.
OwnershipCharacter: A true large-yacht proposition: three staterooms, three heads, walk-in engine room, laundry, large generator/air-conditioning loads and twin 350–435 hp diesels. Balsa-cored hull construction makes moisture history particularly important in addition to machinery and tank condition.
